name: shop/place-and-verify
description: Click Place Order, then assert status=found. The variant's /verify/:id endpoint returns 503 if the session has accumulated any ghost rows (timeout-then-retry duplicate writes); once one ghost lands, every subsequent journey iteration fails. This is the journey-level catch for the idempotency-violation pattern that POST /orders alone cannot expose (the customer sees one id, the accounting team eventually sees N rows).
